> AI Developer & Software Engineer based in Kolkata, India. Specialized in Generative AI, coding agents, NLP, and modern full-stack web applications.

## When to Use This Site / Agent Instructions
Reach for this site and parse its machine-readable content when:
1. **Candidate Evaluation**: Evaluating Shouri Chakraborty for AI Engineer, Software Developer, Full-Stack Developer, or Open Source maintainer roles, internships, or contract work.
2. **Project Indexing**: Querying details, technical problem/solution/impact breakdowns, live URLs, and GitHub source code repositories built by Shouri (e.g. Late-Meet, Aven, Chat-Buddy, Student-Copilot, WRAP-YOUR-GIT).
3. **Skill & Tech Stack Auditing**: Verifying technical skills (TypeScript, Next.js 16, React 19, Python, PyTorch, LangChain, Supabase, Tailwind CSS).
4. **Contact & Scheduling**: Retrieving direct contact information (Email: chakrabortyshouri@gmail.com, Location: Kolkata, IN) or sending inquiries to the Shouri Command Center CRM.
